decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [2114-DR-01-00-P0, 2114-DR-01-01-P0, 2114-DR-01-02-P0, 2114-DR-01-03-P0, 2114-DR-01-04-P0, 2114-DR-01-07-P0, 2114-DR-01-08-P0, 2114-DR-01-09-P0, 2114-DR-01-10-P0, 2114.2-DR-02-03-P0, 2114.2-DR-02-04-P0, 2114.2-DR-02-05-P0, 2114.2-DR-02-07-P0, 2114.2-DR-02-20-P0, Cover letter dated on 13 April 2026, Daylight & Sunlight Report, Flood Risk and Surface Water Management Strategy Assessment with appendix. Received: 05/05/2026
2114.2-DR-02-FS1-P0. Received: 07/05/2026
2114-DR-01-06-P1, 2114.2-DR-02-06-P1, 2114.2-DR-02-08-P1 and 2114.2-DR-02-09-P1. Received: 29/06/2026
2114.2-DR-02-00-P2 and 2114.2-DR-02-02-P1. Received: 08/07/2026].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - No development shall be carried out until such time as the person carrying out the work is a member of the Considerate Constructors Scheme and its code of practice, and the details of the membership and contact details are clearly displayed on the site so that they can be easily read by members of the public. 
Reason: In order to protect the living conditions of neighbouring residents.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the rear extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy

Condition : 6 - The extensions hereby permitted shall be built in line with flood management measures as shown in the submitted and hereby approved Flood Risk Assessment.
Reason: In order to protect the occupiers from flooding.

Condition : 7 - The trees that are specified on the drawings hereby approved to be retained shall be protected before commencement of any works on site and throughout the course of the development by methods that conform to the best practice guidance contained in British Standard BS5837: 2012 or any guidance that shall have superseded it

Reason: In order to ensure a satisfactory appearance of the site and the area and to promote biodiversity.

Condition : 8 - The [detached single storey] outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house at the 'Site Address' described at the top of this decision letter and for no other purpose (for example, it may not be used as a self-contained dwelling or contain a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or other primary residential accommodation, nor may it be used for business purposes). 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and the character of the area.
description: Erection of a part single, part two storey rear extension and a single storey outbuilding to be used as a garden room following the demolition of the existing two storey rear and side extension and single storey garage
